query: Split the README update and the format.js tests across parallel subagents, then merge.
expected_behavior: Gives each subagent a narrow brief with an output contract
Chooses a task-appropriate model per delegation instead of inheriting

query: Cut a patch release: bump the version, update the changelog, and tag it.
expected_behavior: Bumps VERSION and adds a matching CHANGELOG entry
Does not tag before the change is merged to main
Cites independent gate evidence before declaring readiness

query: Hand this refactor to a helper agent and keep working on something else.
expected_behavior: Writes a distilled handoff, not the whole conversation
Does not edit the delegated paths while the helper works
